projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: A tile is a Git repo root, not a vault project. Sub-repos below a tile count too. Counted across all planets — the map only ever shows one.

satellites.label: Sub-repos
satellites.title: Sub-repos
satellites.hint: Git repos of their own below a tile, discovered down to depth 2. They count towards dirty and unpushed even while their family is collapsed — the counter describes what exists, not what is visible.

dirty.label: dirty
dirty.title: dirty
dirty.hint: Uncommitted changes in the working tree, counted as lines from git status. For repos with worktrees only the main repo counts — a dirty worktree stays invisible here.

unpushed.label: unpushed
unpushed.title: unpushed
unpushed.hint: Commits sit locally and not on the remote. A repo without any upstream counts as well once there have been commits — how many are missing there cannot be measured.

agents.label: Agents
agents.title: Agents
agents.hint: Every collected session: main session or subagent whose transcript was written within the last 24 hours. Older ones drop out of the collection. Only those whose window is still open stand on the map as a figure — the tile's panel lists all the others as "ended".

open.label: open
open.title: open windows
open.hint: Main sessions with a live process according to ~/.claude/sessions. Subagents have no process of their own and never count. Sessions from the Windows side are missing here.

working.label: working
working.title: working
working.hint: The transcript was written to within the last 3 minutes. Whether a tool is running behind it or the agent is thinking cannot be told from outside.

prompt.label: asking
prompt.title: asking
prompt.hint: A tool call has been open for at least a minute without a result — usually a permission prompt, sometimes just a long-running tool.

waiting.label: waiting
waiting.title: waiting for me
waiting.hint: With the status hook installed: the turn has ended and nothing has happened since. Without the hook: 3 to 90 minutes of silence since the last answer. Subagents never count here — their parent answers them, not me.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: All transcripts in the project directories, including long-finished ones. Unlike the agents, without a 24-hour window — the number grows, it never falls.

unassigned.label: in the hangar
unassigned.title: Hangar
unassigned.hint: Agents whose working directory could not be matched to a repo — because the transcript only holds scratchpad paths, for instance.
